paused_parallel_bar_dip.desc: Vertical pushing exercise for the chest and triceps featuring an isometric pause at the point of maximum tension.

paused_pec_deck_fly_peak_contraction_hol.name: Paused Pec Deck Fly (Peak Contraction Hold)
paused_pec_deck_fly_peak_contraction_hol.desc: Perform Pec Deck flies by bringing the pads together and holding the peak contraction for several seconds before returning to the starting position.

paused_pike_hold.name: Paused Pike Hold
paused_pike_hold.desc: Isometric position with hips elevated and hands on the floor, simulating an inverted V configuration.

paused_pistol_squat.name: Paused Pistol Squat
paused_pistol_squat.desc: Single-leg squat with an isometric pause at the bottom of the movement.

paused_pistol_squat_progression.name: Paused Pistol Squat Progression
paused_pistol_squat_progression.desc: Pistol Squat variation featuring an isometric pause at the bottom or the most challenging point of the movement.

paused_pogo_jump.name: Paused Pogo Jump
paused_pogo_jump.desc: Plyometric jump performed with rapid repetitions and a brief isometric pause at the end of each bounce.

paused_rope_climb.name: Paused Rope Climb
paused_rope_climb.desc: Rope climb with isometric pauses at different heights during the ascent.

paused_seated_calf_raise.name: Paused Seated Calf Raise
paused_seated_calf_raise.desc: Seated calf raise with an isometric pause at the peak of the contraction at the top of the movement.

paused_shrimp_squat.name: Paused Shrimp Squat
paused_shrimp_squat.desc: Unilateral squat where the free leg's knee descends toward the floor, featuring an isometric pause at the bottom of the movement.

paused_side_plank.name: Paused Side Plank
paused_side_plank.desc: Side plank with a pause held at the point of maximum tension.

paused_single_leg_glute_bridge.name: Paused Single-Leg Glute Bridge
paused_single_leg_glute_bridge.desc: Lifting the hips from the floor with one leg extended and the other flexed, maintaining an isometric pause at the peak contraction.

paused_single_leg_hop.name: Paused Single-Leg Hop
paused_single_leg_hop.desc: Single-leg hop with a brief pause upon landing to improve stability and reactivity.

paused_single_leg_rdl.name: Paused Single-Leg RDL
paused_single_leg_rdl.desc: Single-leg Romanian deadlift performed with an isometric pause at the point of maximum tension.

paused_single_leg_sliding_curl.name: Paused Single-Leg Sliding Curl
paused_single_leg_sliding_curl.desc: Single-leg knee flexion using a sliding disc, featuring an isometric pause at the peak of contraction.

paused_sliding_leg_curl.name: Paused Sliding Leg Curl
paused_sliding_leg_curl.desc: Leg curl variation performed on a sliding surface to emphasize the isometric phase.

paused_split_squat.name: Paused Split Squat
paused_split_squat.desc: Split squat with an isometric pause at the bottom of the movement.

paused_stair_calf_raise.name: Paused Stair Calf Raise
paused_stair_calf_raise.desc: Calf raises performed on a step with the added isometric pause at each phase of the movement.

paused_straight_bar_dip.name: Paused Straight Bar Dip
paused_straight_bar_dip.desc: Dips performed on a straight bar with an isometric pause at the bottom or peak contraction point.

paused_toe_walk.name: Paused Toe Walk
paused_toe_walk.desc: Walking exercise performed by keeping the weight on the balls of the feet with short isometric pauses during each step.

paused_towel_chin_up.name: Paused Towel Chin-Up
paused_towel_chin_up.desc: Chin-ups using a towel for grip, including an isometric pause at the point of maximum contraction.

paused_towel_hang.name: Paused Towel Hang
paused_towel_hang.desc: A passive hang using a towel to increase grip challenge, incorporating an isometric pause.

paused_wall_triceps_extension.name: Paused Wall Triceps Extension
paused_wall_triceps_extension.desc: Triceps extension performed by leaning against a wall, incorporating an isometric pause at the point of maximum tension.

paused_wall_walk.name: Paused Wall Walk
paused_wall_walk.desc: Dynamic stability exercise where you walk your hands toward a wall, incorporating isometric pauses during the movement.

paused_wrist_push_up.name: Paused Wrist Push-Up
paused_wrist_push_up.desc: Push-up performed with flexed wrists, featuring an isometric pause at the point of maximum tension.

pec_deck_chest_fly_machine.name: Pec Deck / Chest Fly Machine
pec_deck_chest_fly_machine.desc: Pectoral isolation exercise on a butterfly machine where the elbows are brought together in front of the chest.

pelvic_tilt.name: Pelvic Tilt
pelvic_tilt.desc: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Tilt your pelvis upward to press your lower back into the ground.

pelvic_tilt_into_bridge.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
pelvic_tilt_into_bridge.desc: Lifting the hips off the ground from a supine position with knees bent, integrating an initial pelvic tilt.

pendlay_chest_supported_row.name: Pendlay Chest-Supported Row
pendlay_chest_supported_row.desc: Chest-supported row performed on a bench, emphasizing explosive concentric phase and a controlled reset.

pendlay_row.name: Pendlay Row
pendlay_row.desc: Rowing variation with torso parallel to the floor and barbell starting from the ground each rep.

pendlay_underhand_barbell_row.name: Pendlay Underhand Barbell Row
pendlay_underhand_barbell_row.desc: Barbell row variation where the bar starts from the floor on every rep, performed with an underhand grip.

penguin_jump_jump_rope.name: Penguin Jump (Jump Rope)
penguin_jump_jump_rope.desc: Jump rope exercise where the feet stay close together, simulating a penguin-like movement.

peroneals_stretch.name: Peroneals Stretch
peroneals_stretch.desc: Sit on the ground with legs extended and use a rope to pull the foot inward, stretching the peroneal muscles.

pike_compression_lift.name: Pike Compression Lift
pike_compression_lift.desc: A strength and mobility exercise requiring lifting the body while maintaining an inverted V or compressed position.

pike_hold.name: Pike Hold
pike_hold.desc: Static hold in an inverted V position with weight supported by the hands and feet on the floor.

pike_push_up.name: Pike Push-Up
pike_push_up.desc: Push-ups with hips raised high forming an inverted V; the body angles downward as the arms bend.

pike_to_cobra_push_up.name: Pike-to-cobra Push-up
pike_to_cobra_push_up.desc: A dynamic transition between an inverted V-shape (pike) and a cobra pose through a sequence of push-ups.

pin_press.name: Pin Press
pin_press.desc: Bench press with the barbell resting on rack pins at a specific height, allowing a dead-stop start. Eliminates the stretch reflex to build strength from specific joint angles.

pin_press_chest_level.name: Pin Press (Chest Level)
pin_press_chest_level.desc: Barbell press starting from the safety pins of the rack positioned at chest height.

pin_press_overhead.name: Pin Press Overhead
pin_press_overhead.desc: Vertical press with a barbell starting from a dead stop on safety pins in a rack.

pin_squat.name: Pin Squat
pin_squat.desc: Squat variant where the barbell starts from fixed pins, eliminating the stretch reflex to train concentric strength.

pistol_squat.name: Pistol Squat
pistol_squat.desc: A single-leg squat performed with the non-working leg extended forward.

pistol_squat_progression.name: Pistol Squat Progression
pistol_squat_progression.desc: Unilateral bodyweight squat performed through various difficulty stages to develop strength and and mobility.

planche_lean.name: Planche Lean
planche_lean.desc: Isometric hold with the body tilted forward and arms fully extended.

planche_lean_push_up.name: Planche Lean Push-Up
planche_lean_push_up.desc: Push-ups performed with the torso leaned forward to increase the load on the shoulders.

planche_push_up.name: Planche Push-Up
planche_push_up.desc: A bodyweight pressing exercise where the body is held parallel to the ground throughout the entire push-up movement.

plank.name: Plank
plank.desc: Fundamental isometric core stability exercise. Engages the transversus abdominis, rectus abdominis, obliques, and spinal stabilizers in static contraction.

plate_halo.name: Plate Halo
plate_halo.desc: Rotating a weight plate around the head while keeping the torso stable and the core engaged.

plate_loaded_shoulder_press.name: Plate Loaded Shoulder Press
plate_loaded_shoulder_press.desc: Vertical press on a lever machine with plate loading.

plate_neck_curl.name: Plate Neck Curl
plate_neck_curl.desc: Neck flexion exercise performed by placing a weight plate on the forehead.

plate_pinch.name: Plate Pinch
plate_pinch.desc: Isometric hold of a weight plate using a pinch grip between the thumb and fingers.

plate_pinch_hold.name: Plate Pinch Hold
plate_pinch_hold.desc: Isometric pinch-grip hold: squeeze two smooth plates between fingers and thumb with neutral wrists and shoulders down.

plate_raise.name: Plate Raise
plate_raise.desc: Front raise performed with a weight plate to emphasize the anterior delt and shoulder control.

plyo_push_up.name: Plyo Push Up
plyo_push_up.desc: Explosive push-ups involving pushing the hands off the ground during the concentric phase.

plyometric_push_up.name: Plyometric Push-Up
plyometric_push_up.desc: Explosive push-ups where the push is sufficient to lift the hands off the ground.

pogo_jump.name: Pogo Jump
pogo_jump.desc: Rapid and reactive vertical jumps focusing on ankle drive, keeping the knees nearly fully extended.

posterior_step_to_overhead_reach.name: Posterior Step To Overhead Reach
posterior_step_to_overhead_reach.desc: Reverse lunge with simultaneous overhead arm extension.

posterior_tibialis_stretch.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
posterior_tibialis_stretch.desc: A stretch using a rope to extend the ankle and calf muscles by pulling the foot towards the body.

potty_squat.name: Potty Squat
potty_squat.desc: Bodyweight squat performed with maximum depth to simulate a natural squatting position.

potty_squat_with_support.name: Potty Squat With Support
potty_squat_with_support.desc: Performing a squat with support for balance, maintaining a deep position and an upright torso.

power_clean.name: Power Clean
power_clean.desc: An explosive movement that brings a barbell from the floor to the rack position with a partial reception.

power_clean_and_jerk.name: Power Clean & Jerk
power_clean_and_jerk.desc: Olympic lifting exercise that combines a Power Clean to bring the barbell to the shoulders and a Jerk to push it overhead.

power_clean_grip.name: Power Clean (Grip)
power_clean_grip.desc: An explosive movement starting from the floor to bring the barbell to the chest with a high catch.

power_point_plank.name: Power Point Plank
power_point_plank.desc: From a high plank position, lower your body onto your forearms by alternating one arm at a time.

power_snatch.name: Power Snatch
power_snatch.desc: An explosive movement that brings the barbell from the floor to an overhead receiving position with knees partially flexed.

preacher_curl.name: Preacher Curl
preacher_curl.desc: Scott bench curl: elbows rest on the angled pad, isolating the biceps and limiting shoulder movement.

press_to_handstand.name: Press to Handstand
press_to_handstand.desc: A pushing movement that transitions the body from a seated or squatting position to a full handstand.

prisoner_half_sit_up.name: Prisoner Half Sit-up
prisoner_half_sit_up.desc: Partial torso flexion exercise performed with hands placed behind the head.

pronated_dumbbell_row.name: Pronated Dumbbell Row
pronated_dumbbell_row.desc: Pronated-grip dumbbell row targeting the upper back and posterior deltoids.

pronazione_supinazione.name: Pronazione / Supinazione
pronazione_supinazione.desc: Controlled rotation of the forearm around its longitudinal axis to train the wrist muscles.

prone_twist_on_stability_ball.name: Prone Twist On Stability Ball
prone_twist_on_stability_ball.desc: Performing a torso rotation in a prone position on a stability ball while maintaining lower body stability.

prone_y_raise.name: Prone Y Raise
prone_y_raise.desc: Raising the arms in a Y-shape from a prone position on the floor or a bench.

pseudo_planche_lean.name: Pseudo Planche Lean
pseudo_planche_lean.desc: Isometric hold in a push-up position with the body leaned forward to simulate the planche.

pseudo_planche_push_up.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
pseudo_planche_push_up.desc: Push-up with hands rotated toward hips and torso leaning forward to simulate planche position.

pull_fingertip_hang.name: Pull Fingertip Hang
pull_fingertip_hang.desc: Static hang from a bar using only the fingertips to support the body weight.

pull_in_on_stability_ball.name: Pull-in (on Stability Ball)
pull_in_on_stability_ball.desc: Sitting on a stability ball, roll your hips forward to bring your knees toward your chest, then extend your legs.

pull_up.name: Pull-Up
pull_up.desc: The foundational vertical pulling bodyweight exercise. Pronated grip, primary target the latissimus dorsi with strong involvement of biceps, rhomboids, and lower trapezius.

pull_up_neutral_grip.name: Pull Up (neutral Grip)
pull_up_neutral_grip.desc: Pull-ups performed with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, pulling the chin above the bar.

pulse_hack_squat.name: Pulse Hack Squat
pulse_hack_squat.desc: Hack squat machine exercise involving the execution of partial, pulsing repetitions in the bottom portion of the range of motion.

pulse_squat.name: Pulse Squat
pulse_squat.desc: Bodyweight squat variation featuring small bouncing movements at the bottom of the range of motion.

push_and_pull_bodyweight.name: Push And Pull Bodyweight
push_and_pull_bodyweight.desc: Bodyweight exercise combining a pushing phase and a simulated pulling phase through arm movements.

push_jerk.name: Push Jerk
push_jerk.desc: An explosive vertical push movement that uses leg drive to drive a barbell overhead.

push_press.name: Push Press
push_press.desc: Vertical press of the barbell overhead assisted by a rapid knee bend and leg drive.

push_to_run.name: Push To Run
push_to_run.desc: Dynamic exercise combining a push-up with a rapid sequence of alternating knee-to-chest movements in a plank position.

push_up.name: Push-Up
push_up.desc: Bodyweight push-ups to train the chest, triceps, and shoulders.

push_up_bosu_ball.name: Push-up (bosu Ball)
push_up_bosu_ball.desc: Push-up performed with hands placed on the flat side of a Bosu ball.

push_up_close_grip_off_dumbbell.name: Push-up Close-grip Off Dumbbell
push_up_close_grip_off_dumbbell.desc: Performing push-ups with hands placed on two dumbbells in a close grip to emphasize triceps work.

push_up_inside_leg_kick.name: Push-up Inside Leg Kick
push_up_inside_leg_kick.desc: Push-up combined with a lateral leg kick outward during the ascent phase.

push_up_medicine_ball.name: Push-up Medicine Ball
push_up_medicine_ball.desc: Performing push-ups with hands placed on a medicine ball to increase instability.

push_up_on_bosu_ball.name: Push Up On Bosu Ball
push_up_on_bosu_ball.desc: Performing push-ups with hands placed on the edges of a Bosu ball to increase instability.

push_up_on_lower_arms.name: Push-up On Lower Arms
push_up_on_lower_arms.desc: A pushing exercise performed in a plank position with forearms on the ground.

push_up_on_rings.name: Push-Up on Rings
push_up_on_rings.desc: Push-ups performed with hands on gymnastic rings, requiring high stabilization demands.

push_up_on_stability_ball.name: Push-up (on Stability Ball)
push_up_on_stability_ball.desc: Performing push-ups with hands placed on a stability ball to increase instability and core engagement.

push_up_plus.name: Push-up Plus
push_up_plus.desc: Standard push-up with an additional scapular protraction phase at the top to emphasize the serratus anterior.

push_up_ring_support_hold.name: Push-Up Ring Support Hold
push_up_ring_support_hold.desc: Static hold in the ring support position with hands in a push-up grip.

push_up_to_side_plank.name: Push-up To Side Plank
push_up_to_side_plank.desc: Push-up followed by a torso rotation into a side plank position.

push_up_wall.name: Push-up (wall)
push_up_wall.desc: Push-ups performed while standing and placing the hands against a wall.

push_up_wall_v_2.name: Push-up (wall) V. 2
push_up_wall_v_2.desc: Push-ups performed while standing and placing the hands against a wall.

pvc_overhead_squat.name: PVC Overhead Squat
pvc_overhead_squat.desc: A mobility and technique drill using a PVC pipe to simulate an overhead squat.
